body:
# DailyRewards

DailyRewards is a clean and flexible daily reward plugin for modern Paper servers.

The plugin allows players to claim daily login rewards through a simple and configurable GUI. Rewards are based on a streak system, so players can unlock better rewards by joining and claiming regularly. Server owners can fully configure the reward days, GUI layout, messages and reward commands.

DailyRewards does not force you to use one specific economy or reward system. Instead, rewards are executed through console commands, making the plugin compatible with many other plugins such as economy systems, crate plugins, permission plugins, custom currency plugins and more.

Player progress is stored safely using SQLite and linked to player UUIDs, making the system reliable and suitable for long-term use.

## Key Features

* GUI-based daily reward system
* Configurable reward days
* Daily claim streaks
* Optional streak reset when a day is missed
* Flexible command-based rewards
* SQLite player data storage
* Configurable GUI items, names, lore and slots
* Configurable messages
* Reload command for admins
* Permission support
* Optional PlaceholderAPI support
* Compatible with many economy, crate and custom reward plugins through commands

## Perfect For

* Survival servers
* SMP servers
* Skyblock servers
* Lifesteal servers
* Economy servers
* Minigame hubs
* Community servers

DailyRewards is designed to be lightweight, server-friendly and easy to configure, while still giving server owners enough flexibility to create their own custom daily reward experience.
